At the [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|Sundari Royal Palace]], there was a '''plaza''' at the entry to the place itself.

==Description==
[[File:SundariMuralLightning-TL.png|thumb|left|250px|Darth Sidious tortures Darth Maul in front of the mural in the plaza.]]
The plaza was located on one side of the [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]], and had stairs that led up to the palace. There were several trees in rows in the plaza as well as rows of decorative pillars. There were two cubist murals of [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] fighting [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] that faced to plaza. One was on the side of the stairs that led to the palace, while the other was on an overlooking balcony. That balcony was on the outside of the throne room, and could be used by the ruler to address the people.

==History==
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] addressed the citizens of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] at this plaza after recent terrorist attacks led by [[Shadow Collective/Legends|unknown gangs]] across the city. It was also here that [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] leader [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] came to address the people and win them over by promising to root out and defeat the criminals. The people gathered in the plaza to see Vizsla and [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan]] on the balcony at the palace above showing them the lead criminals - [[Lom Pyke/Legends|Lom Pyke]], [[Ziton Moj/Legends|Ziton Moj]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]. Vizsla was declared to be the new [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].

Shortly after, the people gathered when Vizsla and Bo-Katan presented the imprisoned [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]. Sometime after that, [[Almec/Legends|Almec]] appeared to the people in the plaza and said that Satine Kryze - now imprisoned as he had said to the people - had murdered Vizsla, who wished for Almec to be the [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]].

Soon after, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] [[Battle of Mandalore/Legends|dueled]] Darth Maul and Savage Opress at this plaza after he and the two brothers fell off a balcony at the palace itself. It was here that the Dark Lord [[Shiak|impaled]] Opress, killing him.
